description_en: Queries the NAT firewall interception trend on the overview page
description_zh: 概览页-nat防火墙拦截趋势
name: DescribeNatFirewallDropTrafficTrend

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en: The start time. Specify a UNIX timestamp in seconds. This parameter is required. If this parameter is not specified, the API returns ErrorTimeError (400). Specify a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The value of StartTime must be earlier than the value of EndTime
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间。使用秒级时间戳格式。本参数实际为必填项，未提供时 API 返回 ErrorTimeError(400)。需提供秒级 Unix 时间戳，且 StartTime 应早于 EndTime
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. Specify a UNIX timestamp in seconds. This parameter is required. If this parameter is not specified, the API returns ErrorTimeError (400). Specify a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The value of EndTime must be later than the value of StartTime
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。使用秒级时间戳格式。本参数实际为必填项，未提供时 API 返回 ErrorTimeError(400)。需提供秒级 Unix 时间戳，且 EndTime 应晚于 StartTime
parameters.name: end_time

DataList.description_en: The data list on the overview page

items.description_en: The data list on the overview page

Time.description_en: The data timestamp. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
Time.description_zh: 数据时间。使用秒级Unix时间戳表示

DropSessionMax.description_en: The maximum number of dropped sessions (peak value) within the corresponding period
DropSessionMax.description_zh: 对应周期丢弃的最大值 （峰值）

DropSessionMaxTime.description_en: The period in which the maximum number of dropped sessions occurred. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds, which represents the number of seconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970 (UTC)
DropSessionMaxTime.description_zh: 丢弃最大值所在的周期。使用秒级Unix时间戳表示，即从1970年1月1日（UTC）起经过的秒数
